Definition: Type of business or processing stream
Examples: Upstream (E and P), midstream, downstream (refining), petrochemical
Oil/gas production, transportation, drilling, LNG, refinery, petrochemical (see Table A.1)
Platform, semi-submersible, hydrocracker, ethylene cracker, polyethylene, acetic acid plant, methanol plant (see Table A.2)
Compression, natural gas, liquefaction, vacuum gas oil, methanol regeneration, oxidation section, reaction system, distillation section, tanker loading system (see Table A.3)

Definition: Class of similar equipment units. Each equipment class contains comparable equipment units (e.g. compressors).
Examples: Heat exchangers, compressors, piping, pumps, gas turbines, subsea wellhead and X-mas trees, lifeboats, extruders, subsea BOPs (see Table A.4)

Definition: A subsystem necessary for the equipment unit to function
Examples: Lubrication subunit, cooling subunit, control and monitoring, heating subunit, pelletizing subunit, quenching subunit, refrigeration subunit, reflux subunit, distributed control subunit

Definition: The group of parts of the equipment unit that are commonly maintained (repaired/ restored) as a whole
Examples: Cooler, coupling, gearbox, lubrication oil pump, instrument loop, motor, valve, filter, pressure sensor, temperature sensor, electric circuit
Notes: For some types of equipment, there might not be a MI; e.g. if the equipment class is piping, there might be no MI, but the part could be elbow. While this level can be useful in some cases, it is considered optional in this International Standard.

Examples: Seal, tube, shell, impeller, gasket, filter plate, bolt, nut, etc.
